description: Create the account and the desk for a website you own and get an API key back, so you can install the tracker and read the desk over MCP. Needs site, email and terms_accepted: true (terms: /wake/docs/terms.md, privacy: /wake/docs/privacy.md). One desk per host; rate-limited.

email.description: The owner's email; the desk sign-in and the weekly brief go there.

terms_accepted.description: true once the Terms and Privacy policy are accepted.
